visualCharacteristics.purpose: TAP's fare comparison: route-group pills over cabin tabs, the fares as columns
traits: route groups as pills, cabins as underlined tabs (pills on phones)
fares as card columns with a top border coloured by the fare from 1024px; a sideways-scrolling table on phones
✓ as a green circle, ✕ as a thin cross; notes as (i) tooltips
Compare fares: a dialog to put up to four fares side by side
a caption box with the legend and the notes

contentPattern.structure: One block table: rows Group | name, Cabin | name, the cabin's header row (empty first cell, then the fares), service rows (label, one cell per fare; italic text = the note), Caption | list, Notes | text; optional label rows. See README.

usage.description: TAP's fare pages (tarifas-tap, tap-fares, tarife-tap, tarifs-tap, tariffe-tap) in each language.

reuseGuidance: TAP only. For other comparison tables use table-striped (matrix).
